tasks.answer: Special-passenger/traveler booking detail page = TravelerBookingDetailScreen, exported as TravelerBookingDetailScreen from @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen. Required props: bookId. Caveat from catalog: actions are permission-gated and the screen needs query and router providers.

Bottom sheet = UiPopup (export UiPopup) from @/components/ui/overlay. onClose is required; open defaults to false, position defaults to bottom, safeArea defaults to false. Note: same module also exports UiDialog; FilterSheet is a higher-level business sheet if a filter-specific bottom sheet is wanted.

Login page = SignInPage from @/features/auth/sign-in-page (no required props; optional redirect; needs router/auth-store/i18n context). Top nav bar = UiNavBar from @/components/ui/navigation (no required props). Both surfaced in a single catalog search.

Flight delay compensation list page = FlightDelayCompensationListScreen from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen. Required props: context and onContextChange. Queries are enabled only when the user holds the query permission.
Image viewer = UiImageViewer from @/components/ui/image-viewer. Required props: image, open, onClose; it renders null while closed.
